parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` — carry `is_test: true` and reside in the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package.
